acceptanceCriteria: Heartbeat median <= 50 ms at 880x13.5k and flat to 40k receipts on a quiet host (load <= cores), measurements retained.
body: PR #1415 (JSG lane, seal 2bd689f67) delivered V1-0887/V1-1512 partially; measured only under host load 20-35 (12 cores), so shape only. Heartbeat median 880 tickets x 13.5k receipts: 145 ms -> 47 ms (load 6), 65 ms (load 20-35); 96 ms at 40k receipts. Remaining floor: commit+fsync ~30 ms, observe ~16 ms.
title: Tasks heartbeat: reduce the ~46 ms commit+fsync+observe floor to meet the V1-0887 50 ms median target with headroom
